title: An Unsupervised Machine Learning Approach to Assess the ZIP Code Level Impact of COVID-19 in NYC
summary: NYC health-data clustering identifies differentiated ZIP-code case-growth patterns that agree with Health Department statistics; associations are observational, not causal.
ai_technology: Lasso/RReliefF feature selection and k-means cluster NYC ZIP codes using demographic, mobility and case-growth features.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: NYC health-data clustering identifies differentiated ZIP-code case-growth patterns that agree with Health Department statistics; associations are observational, not causal.
evidence.unknown: The ZIP-code patterns are observational and do not establish causal effects of COVID-19 or individual-level risk.
evidence.ai_role: Lasso/RReliefF feature selection and k-means cluster NYC ZIP codes using demographic, mobility and case-growth features.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
